title: Miqdor so‘zlari: ko‘p, oz, biroz
goal_uz: Dars oxirida much, many, a lot of, a few, a little, too much, too many va enough ni to‘g‘ri tanlaysiz, How much va How many savollarini tuzasiz hamda ovqatlanishingiz haqida 8 ta miqdor so‘zi bilan gapira olasiz.

scenes.title: Bugungi dars: ko‘p, oz, biroz
board: Quantifiers: much · many · a few · a little
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlarni, some va any ni o‘rgandik. Bugun shu bilimga tayanib miqdor so‘zlarini o‘rganamiz: ko‘p, oz, biroz, ortiqcha va yetarli. Dars oxirida o‘zingizning ovqatlanishingiz haqida to‘g‘ri miqdor so‘zlari bilan gapira olasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Last time we learned countable and uncountable nouns. Today we talk about quantity: much, many, a few, a little and enough.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! O‘tgan safar sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlarni o‘rgandik. Bugun miqdor haqida gapiramiz: much, many, a few, a little va enough.

scenes.title: Many va much
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida “ko‘p” so‘zi hamma narsaga mos: ko‘p kitob, ko‘p suv. Inglizchada esa ikkita so‘z bor. Sanaladigan ko‘plik ot bilan many ishlatiladi: many books, many people. Sanalmaydigan ot bilan much: much water, much time, much money. Tanlash uchun otga qarang: bittalab sanasa bo‘ladimi? Bo‘lsa many, bo‘lmasa much.
scenes.say: Many books. Many people. Much water. Much time. Much money.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘p kitob. Ko‘p odam. Ko‘p suv. Ko‘p vaqt. Ko‘p pul.

scenes.title: Much va many qayerda?
board: ✓ Negative: I don't have much time.
✓ Question: Do you have many friends?
scenes.say_native: Muhim narsa: much va many asosan inkor gap va savolda ishlatiladi. “I don’t have much time”, “Do you have many friends?” Darak gapda esa ular rasmiy, kitobiy eshitiladi va oddiy nutqda deyarli aytilmaydi. Bunday gapda biz boshqa ibora ishlatamiz, uni hozir ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: I don't have much time. I don't eat much meat. Do you read many books?
scenes.say_uz: Menda vaqt ko‘p emas. Men ko‘p go‘sht yemayman. Siz ko‘p kitob o‘qiysizmi?

scenes.title: A lot of: darak gapda
board: A lot of / lots of + countable or uncountable
I have a lot of friends.
We drink a lot of tea.

examples.t: She has a lot of friends.
There is a lot of traffic.

scenes.say_native: Darak gapda ko‘p degan ma’noni “a lot of” beradi. Uning yaxshi tomoni: u sanaladigan ko‘plik bilan ham, sanalmaydigan ot bilan ham ishlaydi. “A lot of friends”, “a lot of tea”. Yana “lots of” bor, u biroz erkinroq. Esda tuting: of ni tushirib qoldirmang. “A lot friends” xato, lekin “a lot” o‘zi alohida, gap oxirida kelishi mumkin: “I like it a lot”.
scenes.say: She has a lot of friends. We drink lots of tea. There is a lot of traffic. I like it a lot.
scenes.say_uz: Uning do‘stlari ko‘p. Biz ko‘p choy ichamiz. Tirbandlik juda ko‘p. Menga bu juda yoqadi.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha bilan taqqoslang
board: Uz: ko‘p → Eng: many / much / a lot of
Uz: ko‘p suv → much water / a lot of water
scenes.say_native: Bitta “ko‘p” so‘zi uchun inglizchada uchta tanlov borligi dastlab chalkashtiradi. Oddiy yo‘l: avval gap turiga qarang. Darak gap bo‘lsa, a lot of ni ishlating, u hamma narsaga mos. Inkor yoki savol bo‘lsa, otni tekshiring: sanaladigan bo‘lsa many, sanalmaydigan bo‘lsa much. Shu ikki qadam sizni xatolardan saqlaydi.
scenes.say: For positive sentences use a lot of. For negatives and questions use many with countable nouns and much with uncountable nouns.
scenes.say_uz: Darak gapda a lot of ishlating. Inkor va savolda sanaladigan otlar bilan many, sanalmaydigan otlar bilan much ishlating.

scenes.title: Tipik xatolar
board: ✓ She has a lot of friends.
scenes.say_native: Ikki mashhur xato. Birinchisi: sanalmaydigan ot bilan many, masalan “many money”. Pul sanalmaydi, to‘g‘risi “much money” yoki darak gapda “a lot of money”. Ikkinchisi: sanaladigan ko‘plik bilan much, masalan “much friends”. To‘g‘risi “many friends” yoki darak gapda “a lot of friends”. Xatoni qanday topish kerak: ot turiga qarang.
scenes.say: I don't have much money. She has a lot of friends.
scenes.say_uz: Menda pul ko‘p emas. Uning do‘stlari ko‘p.

scenes.title: Much, many yoki a lot of?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap. Birinchi: I don’t have blank time. Ikkinchi: How blank students are there? Uchinchi: darak gap, we have blank homework today. To‘rtinchi: Do you eat blank vegetables? Much, many yoki a lot of ni tanlang va baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: I don't have blank time. How blank students are there? We have blank homework today. Do you eat blank vegetables?
scenes.say_uz: Menda vaqt yo‘q. Nechta talaba bor? Bugun uy vazifasi ko‘p. Siz ko‘p sabzavot yeysizmi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “I don’t have much time”, vaqt sanalmaydi. Ikkinchi: “How many students are there?”, talabalar sanaladi. Uchinchi: darak gap, “We have a lot of homework today”; homework sanalmaydi, lekin a lot of ikkalasiga ham mos. To‘rtinchi: “Do you eat many vegetables?”, vegetables ko‘plikda sanaladi. Hammasi to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, ofarin.
scenes.say: I don't have much time. How many students are there? We have a lot of homework today. Do you eat many vegetables?
scenes.say_uz: Menda vaqt yo‘q. Nechta talaba bor? Bugun uy vazifasi ko‘p. Siz ko‘p sabzavot yeysizmi?

scenes.title: A few va a little
board: a few apples · a little milk

examples.t: I have a few friends here.
examples.uz: Bu yerda bir nechta do‘stim bor.

scenes.say_native: Endi oz miqdor. “A few” — bir nechta, sanaladigan ko‘plik bilan: a few apples, a few minutes. “A little” — biroz, sanalmaydigan ot bilan: a little milk, a little time. Mantiq many va much bilan bir xil: sanaladigan bo‘lsa few, sanalmaydigan bo‘lsa little. Ikkalasi ham ijobiy ma’noda: ozgina bor, bu yetarli.
scenes.say: I have a few friends here. Add a little salt. We need a few eggs.
scenes.say_uz: Bu yerda bir nechta do‘stim bor. Biroz tuz qo‘shing. Bizga bir nechta tuxum kerak.

scenes.title: Few va little a siz
scenes.say_native: Diqqat: a ni tashlab yuborsak, ma’no o‘zgaradi. “I have a few friends” — bir nechta do‘stim bor, yaxshi. “I have few friends” — deyarli do‘stim yo‘q, afsus. Little ham shunday: “a little time” — biroz vaqt bor, “little time” — vaqt deyarli yo‘q. Hozircha ikkinchi shaklni tanib olsangiz yetadi. Gapirganda esa a few va a little ni ishlating.
scenes.say: I have a few friends. I have few friends. We have a little time. We have little time.
scenes.say_uz: Mening bir nechta do‘stim bor. Mening deyarli do‘stim yo‘q. Bizda biroz vaqt bor. Bizda vaqt deyarli yo‘q.

scenes.title: Few va little adashmasin
board: ✗ a few water / a little apples
✓ a little water / a few apples
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato: few va little ni aralashtirish. “A few water” deb bo‘lmaydi, water sanalmaydi, to‘g‘risi “a little water”. “A little apples” ham xato: to‘g‘risi “a few apples”. Yodlash uchun oddiy hiyla: few va friends — ikkalasi ham f harfi bilan boshlanadi, sanaladigan ot bilan keladi. Little esa suyuqlik kabi massa bilan.
scenes.say: A little water. A few apples. I have a few friends.
scenes.say_uz: Biroz suv. Bir nechta olma. Mening bir nechta do‘stim bor.

scenes.title: A few yoki a little?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap. Birinchi: we need blank sugar. Ikkinchi: I have blank questions. Uchinchi: there is blank cheese. To‘rtinchi: she bought blank oranges. A few yoki a little ni tanlang va gapni to‘liq ayting.
scenes.say: We need blank sugar. I have blank questions. There is blank cheese. She bought blank oranges.
scenes.say_uz: Bizga biroz shakar kerak. Mening bir nechta savolim bor. Biroz pishloq bor. U bir nechta apelsin sotib oldi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) a little sugar  2) a few questions
3) a little cheese  4) a few oranges
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “We need a little sugar”, shakar sanalmaydi. “I have a few questions”, savollar sanaladi. “There is a little cheese”, pishloq sanalmaydi. “She bought a few oranges”, apelsinlar sanaladi. Agar ikkitasini adashtirgan bo‘lsangiz, yuqoridagi hiylani eslang: few — sanaladigan, little — massa.
scenes.say: We need a little sugar. I have a few questions. There is a little cheese. She bought a few oranges.
scenes.say_uz: Bizga biroz shakar kerak. Menda bir nechta savol bor. Biroz pishloq bor. U bir nechta apelsin oldi.

scenes.title: Jadval: qaysi so‘z nima bilan
board: Both: a lot of · some · any · enough
scenes.say_native: Hammasini bir joyga yig‘amiz. Faqat sanaladigan ko‘plik bilan: many, a few, few. Faqat sanalmaydigan ot bilan: much, a little, little. Ikkalasi bilan ishlaydiganlar: a lot of, lots of, some, any, enough. Shu uch qatorni yodlab olsangiz, tanlashda doim to‘g‘ri yo‘l topasiz. Yodlash uchun ularni muzlatgich eshigiga yozib qo‘ying.
scenes.say: Many, a few, few: countable. Much, a little, little: uncountable. A lot of, some, any and enough: both.
scenes.say_uz: Many, a few, few sanaladigan otlar bilan. Much, a little, little sanalmaydigan otlar bilan. A lot of, some, any va enough ikkalasi bilan.

scenes.title: How many? How much?
board: How many eggs? · How much milk?

examples.t: How many eggs do you need?
How many brothers do you have?

scenes.say_native: Miqdorni so‘rash uchun How many va How much bor. Sanaladigan ko‘plik bilan How many: how many eggs, how many brothers. Sanalmaydigan ot bilan How much: how much milk, how much time. So‘ng yordamchi fe’l: “How much sugar do you take?” Javob ko‘pincha son yoki o‘lchov iborasi: “Two”, “A little”, “Half a kilo”.
scenes.say: How many eggs do you need? How much milk is there? How many brothers do you have?
scenes.say_uz: Sizga nechta tuxum kerak? Qancha sut bor? Nechta akangiz bor?

scenes.title: How much — narx
board: How much is it? · How much are they?
It's two pounds. · They're three pounds.
scenes.say_native: How much yana bir muhim vazifani bajaradi: narxni so‘raydi. Birlikda: “How much is this bread?” Ko‘plikda fe’l o‘zgaradi: “How much are these apples?” Bu yerda much narxga ishora qiladi, shuning uchun ko‘plik ot bo‘lsa ham fe’l are bo‘ladi. Javob: “It’s two pounds” yoki “They’re three pounds”. Dukonda eng kerakli savol.
scenes.say: How much is this bread? How much are these apples? It's two pounds. They're three pounds.
scenes.say_uz: Bu non necha pul? Bu olmalar necha pul? Ikki funt. Uch funt.

scenes.title: How much va How many xatolari
board: ✗ How many money do you have?
✓ How much money do you have?
scenes.say_native: Ikkita xato. Birinchisi: “How many money”. Pul sanalmaydi, to‘g‘risi “How much money”. Ikkinchisi: “How much people”. People sanaladi, to‘g‘risi “How many people”. Yana bir tuzoq: how many dan keyin fe’l ko‘plikka mos: “How many people are there?”, “is there” emas. Savol tuzayotganda avval otni aniqlang.
scenes.say: How much money do you have? How many people are there?
scenes.say_uz: Sizda qancha pul bor? U yerda nechta odam bor?

scenes.title: Savol tuzing
scenes.say_native: Bo‘sh joyga how much yoki how many ni qo‘ying. Birinchi: blank sugar do you take? Ikkinchi: blank children does she have? Uchinchi: blank is this ticket? To‘rtinchi: blank cars are there? Savolni to‘liq ayting.
scenes.say: Blank sugar do you take? Blank children does she have? Blank is this ticket? Blank cars are there?
scenes.say_uz: Shakarni qancha olasiz? Uning nechta bolasi bor? Bu bilet necha pul? U yerda nechta mashina bor?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “How much sugar do you take?”, shakar sanalmaydi. Ikkinchi: “How many children does she have?”, bolalar sanaladi. Uchinchi: “How much is this ticket?”, bu yerda narx so‘ralyapti. To‘rtinchi: “How many cars are there?”, mashinalar sanaladi. Narx so‘rasangiz doim how much.
scenes.say: How much sugar do you take? How many children does she have? How much is this ticket? How many cars are there?
scenes.say_uz: Shakarni qancha olasiz? Uning nechta bolasi bor? Bu bilet necha pul? U yerda nechta mashina bor?

scenes.title: Too much va too many
board: too much sugar · too many cars

examples.t: There is too much sugar in this tea.
There are too many cars in the city.

scenes.say_native: Too much va too many — “ortiqcha ko‘p”, ya’ni me’yordan oshgan va bu yomon. Tuzilishi oddiy: too much + sanalmaydigan ot, too many + sanaladigan ko‘plik ot. “Too much sugar”, “too many cars”. Bu iboralar darak gapda ham bemalol ishlatiladi, chunki ular ijobiy ma’noda emas, shikoyat ohangida. Masalan: “I eat too much bread”.
scenes.say: There is too much sugar in this tea. There are too many cars in the city. I eat too much bread.
scenes.say_uz: Bu choyda shakar juda ko‘p. Shaharda mashina juda ko‘p. Men juda ko‘p non yeyman.

scenes.title: Too + sifat
board: too + adjective: too hot, too big
scenes.say_native: Too sifat bilan ham ishlatiladi: “too hot”, “too big”, “too late”. Bu yerda much va many kerak emas: “too much hot” xato. Qoida: too + sifat; too much/many + ot. “The soup is too hot” — sho‘rva juda issiq, ichib bo‘lmaydi. “There is too much soup” — sho‘rva juda ko‘p. Ikkala gapning mantiqi har xil, fikr yuritib tanlang.
scenes.say: The soup is too hot. It's too late. There is too much soup.
scenes.say_uz: Sho‘rva juda issiq. Juda kech. Sho‘rva juda ko‘p.

scenes.title: Enough va not enough
scenes.say_native: Enough — yetarli. Otdan oldin keladi: “enough time”, “enough chairs”. Sifatdan keyin keladi: “big enough”, “old enough”. Bu tartibni yodlab oling, chunki o‘zbekchada “yetarlicha katta” desak, so‘z tartibi boshqacha. Inkor shakl: “not enough”: “There isn’t enough milk”. Enough sanaladigan ko‘plik bilan ham, sanalmaydigan ot bilan ham ishlaydi.
scenes.say: We have enough chairs. The room is big enough. There isn't enough milk.
scenes.say_uz: Bizda stullar yetarli. Xona yetarlicha katta. Sut yetarli emas.

scenes.title: Enough o‘rni va too much
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: enough ni sifatdan oldin qo‘yish, “enough big”. To‘g‘risi “big enough”. Ikkinchisi: sanaladigan ot bilan too much, “too much people”. To‘g‘risi “too many people”. Qoida: sifatdan keyin enough; sanaladigan ko‘plik bilan too many; sanalmaydigan ot bilan too much.
scenes.say: The room is big enough. There are too many people.
scenes.say_uz: Xona yetarlicha katta. Odamlar juda ko‘p.

scenes.title: Too yoki enough?
board: 1) There are ___ cars in the street. (too many)
2) I can't sleep. There is ___ noise.
3) The bag is not ___ for my laptop. (big)
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap. Birinchi: ko‘chada mashina juda ko‘p, there are blank cars. Ikkinchi: shovqin juda ko‘p, there is blank noise. Uchinchi: sumka noutbuk uchun yetarlicha katta emas. To‘rtinchi: bizda vaqt yetarli. Inglizchasini ayting.
scenes.say: There are blank cars in the street. There is blank noise. The bag is not blank for my laptop. We have blank time.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘chada mashina juda ko‘p. Shovqin juda ko‘p. Sumka noutbuk uchun yetarlicha katta emas. Bizda vaqt yetarli.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) too many cars  2) too much noise
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “There are too many cars in the street”, mashinalar sanaladi. Ikkinchi: “There is too much noise”, shovqin sanalmaydi. Uchinchi: “The bag is not big enough for my laptop”, enough sifatdan keyin. To‘rtinchi: “We have enough time. Let’s go!”, enough otdan oldin. Hammasini topdingizmi? Zo‘r.
scenes.say: There are too many cars. There is too much noise. The bag is not big enough. We have enough time.
scenes.say_uz: Mashina juda ko‘p. Shovqin juda ko‘p. Sumka yetarlicha katta emas. Vaqtimiz yetarli.

scenes.title: Dialog 1: shifokor qabulida
board: Doctor: How much water do you drink?
Patient: Not much, only a little.
Doctor: And how many cups of coffee?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog shifokor qabulida. Shifokor bemorning odatlari haqida so‘raydi. How much va how many savollariga, hamda bemor qanday qisqa javob berishiga e’tibor bering. Keyin savollarga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Doctor: How much water do you drink every day? Patient: Not much, only a little. Doctor: And how many cups of coffee? Patient: Five or six. Doctor: That's too many. You should drink more water and have fewer coffees.
scenes.say_uz: Shifokor: Har kuni qancha suv ichasiz? Bemor: Ko‘p emas, ozgina. Shifokor: Qahvadan nechta piyola? Bemor: Besh-olti. Shifokor: Bu juda ko‘p. Ko‘proq suv ichishingiz va kamroq qahva ichishingiz kerak.

scenes.title: Dialog 1 haqida savollar
board: 1) How much water does he drink?
2) How many coffees does he drink?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: bemor qancha suv ichadi? Ikkinchi: u nechta qahva ichadi? Uchinchi: shifokor nima deb o‘ylaydi? Javobni to‘liq gap bilan ayting, miqdor so‘zini ishlating.
scenes.say: How much water does he drink? How many coffees does he drink? What does the doctor think?
scenes.say_uz: U qancha suv ichadi? U nechta qahva ichadi? Shifokor nima deb o‘ylaydi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: u ko‘p suv ichmaydi, “only a little”. Ikkinchi: besh-olti qahva ichadi, “five or six”. Uchinchi: shifokor “that’s too many” deydi, ya’ni qahva juda ko‘p. Ko‘rdingizmi, qisqa javobda ham miqdor so‘zi tabiiy ishlatiladi: “a little”, “too many”.
scenes.say: He drinks only a little water. He drinks five or six coffees. The doctor says that is too many.
scenes.say_uz: U ozgina suv ichadi. U besh-olti qahva ichadi. Shifokor bu juda ko‘p deydi.

scenes.title: Dialog 2: ziyofatga tayyorgarlik
board: A: How many people are coming?
B: About twelve. Do we have enough chairs?
A: No, we need a few more.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog: ikki do‘st ziyofatga tayyorlanmoqda. Ular odamlar soni, stullar va ovqat haqida gaplashadi. Enough, a few va how many qanday ishlatilganiga quloq soling, keyin ikkita savol bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Sam: How many people are coming? Lily: About twelve. Do we have enough chairs? Sam: No, we only have eight. We need a few more. Lily: And there isn't much juice. I'll buy two litres.
scenes.say_uz: Sem: Nechta odam keladi? Lili: Taxminan o‘n ikkita. Stullarimiz yetarlimi? Sem: Yo‘q, bizda faqat sakkizta. Yana bir nechta kerak. Lili: Sharbat ham ko‘p emas. Ikki litr olaman.

scenes.title: Dialog 2 haqida savollar
board: 2) Why do they need more chairs?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: nechta mehmon keladi? Ikkinchi: nima uchun ularga ko‘proq stul kerak? Uchinchi: Lili nima sotib oladi? Javobni inglizcha, to‘liq gap bilan ayting.
scenes.say: How many guests are coming? Why do they need more chairs? What will Lily buy?
scenes.say_uz: Nechta mehmon keladi? Nima uchun ko‘proq stul kerak? Lili nima sotib oladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) They only have eight. It is not enough.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: taxminan o‘n ikkita mehmon. Ikkinchi: ularda faqat sakkizta stul bor, bu yetarli emas, “not enough”, shuning uchun yana bir nechta, “a few more”, kerak. Uchinchi: Lili ikki litr sharbat sotib oladi, “two litres of juice”, chunki sharbat ko‘p emas, “there isn’t much juice”. O‘tgan darsdagi o‘lchov iborasini ham ko‘rdingiz.
scenes.say: About twelve guests. They only have eight chairs. Lily buys two litres of juice.
scenes.say_uz: Taxminan o‘n ikki mehmon. Ularda faqat sakkizta stul bor. Lili ikki litr sharbat oladi.

scenes.title: Qisqa javoblar
board: How many? → A lot. / Quite a few. / Not many. / None.
How much? → A lot. / A little. / Not much. / None.
How much sugar? → Just a little.

examples.t: How many friends? — Quite a few.

scenes.say_native: Gapirganda ko‘pincha to‘liq gap aytilmaydi. How many ga javob: “A lot”, “Quite a few” — birmuncha, “Not many” — ko‘p emas, “None” — hech qancha. How much ga: “A lot”, “A little”, “Not much”, “None”. Shu qisqa javoblar suhbatni tabiiy qiladi. Esda tuting: sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan farqi javobda ham saqlanadi: “Not many”, lekin “Not much”.
scenes.say: How many friends? Quite a few. How much time? Not much. How much sugar? Just a little.
scenes.say_uz: Nechta do‘st? Birmuncha. Qancha vaqt? Ko‘p emas. Qancha shakar? Ozgina.

scenes.title: Yana tabiiy iboralar

examples.t: I need a bit of help.

scenes.say_native: Ingliz tilida yana bir necha tabiiy ibora bor. “A bit of” — biroz, “a little” ning erkin varianti: “a bit of help”, “a bit of sugar”. “Plenty of” — yetarlidan ham ko‘p: “We have plenty of time”, vaqtimiz mo‘l. Va juda erkin “loads of” — Britaniyada keng tarqalgan, “loads of people”. Rasmiy yozuvda esa a lot of va a large number of ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: I need a bit of help. We have plenty of time. There are loads of people.
scenes.say_uz: Menga biroz yordam kerak. Bizda vaqt yetarlicha ko‘p. U yerda odamlar juda ko‘p.

scenes.title: Qisqa javob bering
board: 1) How many languages do you speak?
2) How much sugar do you take in tea?
3) How many cups of tea do you drink?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga qisqa va tabiiy javob bering. Birinchi: nechta til bilasiz? Ikkinchi: choyga qancha shakar solasiz? Uchinchi: kuniga nechta piyola choy ichasiz? Javobda a few, a little, a lot, not many yoki not much ni ishlating.
scenes.say: How many languages do you speak? How much sugar do you take in tea? How many cups of tea do you drink?
scenes.say_uz: Nechta til bilasiz? Choyga qancha shakar solasiz? Nechta piyola choy ichasiz?

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
scenes.say_native: Mana variantlar. Birinchi: “A few” yoki aniq son, “Three”. Ikkinchi: “Just a little” yoki “Not much”. Uchinchi: “Quite a lot” yoki “Not many”. Sizniki boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi tanlov to‘g‘ri bo‘lsin: languages va cups uchun many yoki a few, sugar uchun much yoki a little. Ofarin!
scenes.say: A few. Just a little. Quite a lot. Not many.
scenes.say_uz: Bir nechta. Ozgina. Ancha ko‘p. Ko‘p emas.

scenes.title: Much darak gapda ham bor
board: very much · too much · so much · as much as
I like it very much. / I love you so much.
scenes.say_native: Oldin aytdik, darak gapda much kam ishlatiladi. Lekin bir necha tayyor iboralar bor: “very much”, “too much”, “so much”, “as much as”. “Thank you very much” — katta rahmat. “I miss you so much” — sizni juda sog‘indim. “Eat as much as you like” — xohlaganingizcha yeng. Ularni yodlab oling, bular qoidadan istisno emas, shunchaki qotib qolgan iboralar.
scenes.say: Thank you very much. I miss you so much. Eat as much as you like.
scenes.say_uz: Katta rahmat. Sizni juda sog‘indim. Xohlaganingizcha yeng.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: a lot of, much, many
board: a lot of /ə ˈlɒt əv/ → “a lotta”
scenes.say_native: Tabiiy nutqda “a lot of” bir so‘zdek aytiladi, a, lot, of tez qo‘shilib, “a lotta” kabi. Urg‘u lot ga tushadi. Much — “mach”, qisqa unli va ch bilan tugaydi. Many — “meni”, birinchi bo‘g‘inda urg‘u, e unlisi “e” kabi, “mani” emas. Few — “fyu”, little — “litl”, ikkinchi l bo‘g‘in hosil qiladi.
scenes.say: A lot of people. Much money. Many people. A few friends. A little time.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘p odam. Ko‘p pul. Ko‘p odam. Bir nechta do‘st. Biroz vaqt.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
board: a few friends, a little time
scenes.say_native: Meni takrorlang. A lot of ni tez va qo‘shib ayting, many da birinchi bo‘g‘inga urg‘u bering, much da unli qisqa bo‘lsin. Har bir iborani ikki marta aytib chiqing.
scenes.say: A lot of people. How much? How many? A few friends. A little time.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘p odam. Qancha? Nechta? Bir nechta do‘st. Biroz vaqt.

scenes.title: Tekshiruv
scenes.say_native: Yaxshi chiqdi. Esda tuting: ingliz tilida so‘zlar ajratib emas, ketma-ket oqim bilan aytiladi. “A lot of people” — birdan, to‘xtashsiz. Bu odatni o‘zlashtirsangiz, nutqingiz ancha tabiiy eshitiladi. Keyingi bosqichda o‘zingiz haqingizda gapirasiz, endi bilimlarni birlashtiramiz.
scenes.say: Say a lot of people in one flow.
scenes.say_uz: A lot of people ni bir oqimda ayting.

scenes.title: Ovqatlanishingiz haqida gapiring
board: I eat a lot of ... / I don't eat much ...
I drink a little ... / too much ... / enough ...
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz gapiring. Ovqatlanishingiz haqida to‘rtta gap ayting. Masalan: I eat a lot of bread. I don’t drink much milk. I eat a few apples every day. I drink too much tea. Kamida to‘rtta xil miqdor so‘zi ishlating.
scenes.say: Tell me about your diet. I eat a lot of bread. I don't drink much milk. I eat a few apples every day. I drink too much tea.
scenes.say_uz: Ovqatlanishingiz haqida ayting. Men ko‘p non yeyman. Ko‘p sut ichmayman. Har kuni bir nechta olma yeyman. Juda ko‘p choy ichaman.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: I eat a lot of rice and a few vegetables.
I eat too much sugar. I don't eat enough fruit.
scenes.say_native: Mana boshqa namuna. “I eat a lot of rice and a few vegetables. I don’t drink much water. I eat too much sugar and I don’t eat enough fruit.” Ko‘rdingizmi, darak gapda a lot of, inkorda much, sanaladigan sabzavot bilan a few, shikoyat bilan too much, yetishmovchilik uchun not enough. Siz ham shunday birlashtirdingizmi?
scenes.say: I eat a lot of rice and a few vegetables. I don't drink much water. I eat too much sugar. I don't eat enough fruit.
scenes.say_uz: Men ko‘p guruch va bir nechta sabzavot yeyman. Ko‘p suv ichmayman. Juda ko‘p shakar yeyman. Yetarli meva yemayman.

scenes.title: Xatolarni to‘g‘rilang
board: 3) How many money do you need?
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy mashq: to‘rtta gapdagi xatoni to‘g‘rilang. Birinchi: I don’t have many time. Ikkinchi: there are too much cars. Uchinchi: how many money do you need? To‘rtinchi: we have a little eggs. Har birini to‘g‘ri ayting.
scenes.say: Correct these sentences. I don't have many time. There are too much cars. How many money do you need? We have a little eggs.
scenes.say_uz: Bu gaplarni to‘g‘rilang. Menda vaqt ko‘p emas. Mashinalar juda ko‘p. Sizga qancha pul kerak? Bizda bir nechta tuxum bor.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri variantlar
board: 3) How much money do you need?
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri variantlar. Birinchi: “I don’t have much time”, vaqt sanalmaydi. Ikkinchi: “There are too many cars”, mashinalar sanaladi. Uchinchi: “How much money do you need?”, pul sanalmaydi. To‘rtinchi: “We have a few eggs”, tuxumlar sanaladi. Har bir xatoning ildizi bitta edi: ot turini tekshirmaslik.
scenes.say: I don't have much time. There are too many cars. How much money do you need? We have a few eggs.
scenes.say_uz: Menda vaqt ko‘p emas. Mashinalar juda ko‘p. Sizga qancha pul kerak? Bizda bir nechta tuxum bor.

scenes.title: Xulosa
board: Countable: many · a few · too many
Uncountable: much · a little · too much
Both: a lot of · enough · some · any
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Sanaladigan ko‘plik ot bilan many, a few, too many. Sanalmaydigan ot bilan much, a little, too much. Ikkalasi bilan a lot of, enough, some, any. Darak gapda a lot of, inkor va savolda much va many. Savolda sanaladigan ot bilan how many, sanalmaydigan ot yoki narx bilan how much. Sifatdan keyin enough.
scenes.say: Use many and a few with countable nouns. Use much and a little with uncountable nouns. Use a lot of and enough with both.
scenes.say_uz: Sanaladigan otlar bilan many va a few ishlating. Sanalmaydigan otlar bilan much va a little. A lot of va enough ikkalasi bilan ishlaydi.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Describe your diet using 8 quantity words
a lot of · much · many · a few · a little
too much / too many · enough / not enough
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: ovqatlanishingizni sakkizta miqdor so‘zi bilan tasvirlang. Masalan, a lot of, much, many, a few, a little, too much, too many, enough. Tekshiring: many faqat sanaladigan ko‘plik bilan, much faqat sanalmaydigan ot bilan, darak gapda a lot of. Keyingi darsda va, lekin, chunki, shuning uchun kabi bog‘lovchilarni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to describe your diet with eight quantity words. Next time we learn and, but, because and so.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz sakkizta miqdor so‘zi bilan ovqatlanishingizni tasvirlash. Keyingi darsda and, but, because va so ni o‘rganamiz.

homework_uz: O‘z ovqatlanishingiz haqida 8 ta gap yozing va 8 xil miqdor so‘zi ishlating: a lot of, much, many, a few, a little, too much, too many, enough (yoki not enough). Mezon: many faqat sanaladigan ko‘plik bilan, much faqat sanalmaydigan ot bilan, darak gapda much/many o‘rniga a lot of, har bir gapda ot to‘g‘ri turda.

options: I don't have a few money.
I don't have a little moneys.
quiz.why_uz: Money sanalmaydi, shuning uchun much ishlatiladi. Many faqat sanaladigan ko‘plik bilan keladi.
Eggs sanaladi, shuning uchun How many eggs.

quiz.q: Which is natural in a positive sentence?
options: I have many friends in London.
I have a lot of friends in London.
I have much friends in London.
I have a lot friends in London.
quiz.why_uz: Darak gapda a lot of tabiiyroq. Much friends xato, a lot friends ham xato (of kerak).

quiz.q: I need ___ minutes to finish. (a small number)
quiz.why_uz: Minutes sanaladi: a few minutes. A little esa sanalmaydigan otlar bilan.

quiz.q: There is ___ sugar in my tea. (a small amount)
You drink ___ coffee. It is bad for you.
quiz.why_uz: Coffee sanalmaydi, shuning uchun too much coffee.

quiz.q: The room is not ___ for ten people.
quiz.why_uz: Sifatdan keyin enough: big enough. Otdan oldin: enough chairs.
Narx so‘ralganda How much is it? deyiladi.
People sanaladi (ko‘plik): How many people are there?

quiz.q: “Do you have any sisters?” — “Yes, ___ .” (two or three)
quiz.why_uz: Sisters sanaladi, qisqa javob: Yes, a few.
